testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, link, input, select, tab, checkbox, card) and major statistical display MUST include a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure all code files use React .js / .jsx extensions in /src.

2. Implement a complete, fully functional single-page-app with client-side routing or view switching for all key pages: Homepage, University Directory & Profiles, Course Directory & Profiles, University Comparison Engine (2-4 universities side-by-side), Course Comparison Engine, Online vs Distance Explainer, Knowledge Hub & Guides, Get Guidance Lead Form, Landing Pages system, Shortlist Drawer, and Admin CMS Dashboard.
3. Use Lucide icons (@lucide/react or lucide-react) for all icons; NEVER use emojis for icons.
4. Add Sonner toast notifications when users add/remove items from shortlist or submit lead forms.
5. Use high contrast, APCA-compliant text over dark or light backgrounds. Never use transparent headers without blur or background fill.

6. Include mock data for at least 8-12 realistic Indian and global universities (e.g. Amity Online, Chandigarh University Online, NMIMS Global, Manipal Online, DU SOL, IGNOU, BITS Pilani Work Integrated) with accurate details (NAAC ratings, UGC/DEB approvals, fee ranges, EMI options, placement support).
7. Include all required testing attributes (`data-testid`) across every component.
8. Maintain a premium, trust-first, modern technology feel matching the ETI EduConnect™ branding.
